name: Directional overcurrent
summary: An overcurrent function with a documented direction criterion.
description: Directional overcurrent combines an overcurrent operating condition with a direction criterion defined by the device and application. Its full name and suffix can distinguish phase and earth-fault implementations, measurement inputs and operating stages.

On a power drawing, keep this function reference connected to the selected equipment and its complete designation. A multifunction relay can implement several numbered functions. This entry explains the reference; it supplies no settings or commissioning procedure.
readingNotes: Identify the current input and the documented direction reference.
Follow the forward/reverse convention used in the protection scheme.
drawingChecklist: Identify the relay element and associated trip logic.
distinction: A 67 reference is not the same as directional power 32. Their quantities and operating criteria differ.
